definitions.explanation: A cord or strap worn around the neck to hold something such as an ID card, key, smartphone, or whistle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員証|しゃいんしょう}→社員証：22652_shainshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{首紐|くびひも}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ぶら{下|さ}げる→ぶら下げる：10613_burasageru⟧。
examples.english: I hang my employee ID from a neck strap.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{首紐|くびひも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{落|お}とさない→落とす：01246_otosu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I attach a neck strap to my smartphone so I don't drop it.

examples.japanese: {展示会場|てんじかいじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}→来場者：19023_raijousha⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{首紐|くびひも}つき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名札|なふだ}→名札：12338_nafuda⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{配|くば}られた→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: At the exhibition venue, neck-strap nametags were distributed to every visitor.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧ (neck) + ⟦{紐|ひも}→紐：02251_himo⟧ (cord, string).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首紐|くびひも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to attach a neck strap
- {首紐|くびひも}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ぶら{下|さ}げる→ぶら下げる：10613_burasageru⟧: to hang from a neck strap
- {首紐|くびひも}つき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名札|なふだ}→名札：12338_nafuda⟧: a nametag with a neck strap
- ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧{首紐|くびひも}: smartphone neck strap

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ストラップ: strap — broader loanword for any kind of strap (wrist, neck, bag)
- ネックストラップ: neck strap — the katakana equivalent, common on product labels
- ランヤード: lanyard — used mainly in safety or industrial contexts
